title: Complex WinUI 3 hot reload acceptance journey
description: A demanding authored-edit journey for winapp run --watch that builds a multi-page WinUI 3 app one save at a time.
It intentionally passes through invalid intermediate saves for package, style, event, templated-control, project-reference, move, and rename orderings.
Every checkpoint is expected to build and to prove observable UI through UI Automation.
